Messages.Author: cookjf@wkuvx1.wku.edu
Messages.Body:
Having just recently joined this newsgroup, I keep seeing references
to the confused rulings on the Army of Rats card. Can someone please
tell me what the current ruling is? Do multiple AoR 'stack' for
multiple damage or not?
                                           Thanks,
                                             JC

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
Army of Rats has errata to the effect that it is not cumulative.
If you have 2, 3, or even 10 Armies out, your prey is still losing
just one pool during each of your untap phases.
